prompts.szene: Editorial e-commerce photograph. Only the coat on its hanger: the orange handbag from the reference photo is not part of the product and must not appear. Calm, high-end interior, soft natural window light from the left, late autumn mood in Switzerland, muted warm neutral tones, a hint of pale wooden floor, gentle soft shadows on the wall. Do not change the product in any way: identical shape, proportions, colors, pattern, details and number of parts. No people, no hands, no faces, no mannequin, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks. Landscape composition, product clearly visible right of center, calm uncluttered background on the left.
prompts.video_v1_verworfen: Calm cinemagraph of a still-life scene. All objects stay completely still and unchanged: the cream trench coat on its wooden hanger keeps its exact shape, colors, lapels, puffed shoulders, three tortoiseshell buttons, flap pockets, cuff tabs and lining, and it does not swing or sway; the brass rail stays fixed. Only the soft natural morning light slowly drifts across the warm-white plaster wall and the pale wooden floor, a faint shadow of a sheer curtain from the window on the left moves very gently over the wall, and the camera performs an extremely slow, subtle push-in. No people, no hands, no text, no logos, no new objects. Seamless loop: the last frame is identical to the first frame.
prompts.video: Calm cinemagraph of a still-life scene. The camera is locked off, only the light changes. The brass rail, the wall, the floor and the window stay exactly as they are. Only the soft, diffuse morning light very slowly brightens and dims a little on the warm-white plaster wall, with soft gentle shadows only, no hard sunbeams. No curtains, no people, no hands, no text, no logos, no new objects, nothing enters the frame. Seamless loop: the last frame is identical to the first frame.

Orange Handtasche und weisses Shirt aus dem Original nicht übernommen (nicht Teil des Produkts). Keine Schrift, Logos, Personen, Hände. Mantel rechts der Mitte, links ruhige Wand mit Fenster. Treu, ein Versuch.

Versuch 2 (19565ffd, Kamera fest, nur Licht): Kontaktbogen und Ausschnitte bei 0/2/3,3/4,5/6,2 s zeigen Form, Revers, gepuffte Schultern, drei Knöpfe, Pattentaschen, Ärmelriegel und Futter unverändert; Stange und Bügel stehen still, keine neuen Objekte, keine Schrift. Bewegung: das Licht wird zur Mitte heller (Mantel-Helligkeit 184 auf 209 von 255) und weiche Fensterschatten erscheinen auf der Wand, danach zurück.
